artworks.title: Neoptolemus Slays Eurypylus (Attic black-figure amphora)
artworks.description: Shoulder of Martin-von-Wagner-Museum L 309 (from Vulci): Neoptolemus has cut down Eurypylus and pursues the charioteer until Apollo steps in with the bow. The Mysian son of Telephus — Troy's late ally from the Little Iliad cycle — dies in black-figure before Achilles' son.
